message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data acquisition code paths; files are opened and read directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to training samples in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code calls LoadModel(modelPath, consts) to load a serialized model from a file path, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the provided code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in any part of the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or adversarial perturbation methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (GenerateFile, GenerateLargeFile, GenerateData, GenerateLargeData) passes files and sequences directly to model.predict() without any shape, range, or schema validation of the input data.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from model.predict() are used directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks visible in the inference code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a point-cloud segmentation pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
